caption: Trevi Fountain, Rome
composition: Baroque fountain facade in afternoon light · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera stands at the piazza edge facing the Trevi Fountain head on in the early afternoon. The travertine facade fills the frame: Corinthian columns frame the central arch, with Oceanus above the cascade and a niche and statue to either side. The attic panel is carved CLEMENS XII PONT MAX, AQVAM VIRGINEM, COPIA ET SALVBRITATE COMMENDATAM, CVLTV MAGNIFICO ORNAVIT, ANNO DOMINI MDCCXXXV PONT VI, and the frieze reads PERFECIT BENEDICTVS XIV PONT MAX. Ochre palazzi close in on left and right, and the basin spreads across the foreground. The modelled scenario is 30 September 2026 at 14:25 Europe/Rome: mainly clear, 26.6°C, cloud cover 49 percent, bright afternoon sun.
